import "member.csv" as member.
import "grant.csv" as grant.
import "includes.csv" as includes.
import "permit.csv" as permit.
import "revoked.csv" as revoked.

% Transitive closure for role inclusions
included(Role, IncludedRole) :- includes(Role, IncludedRole).
included(Role, IncludedIncludedRole) :- includes(Role, IntermediateRole), included(IntermediateRole, IncludedIncludedRole).

% User has a role if they are in a group granted it, and includes all included roles
user_role(User, Role) :- member(User, Group), grant(Group, BaseRole), included(BaseRole, Role).

% Check if user has permission to read r03
has_permission(User, "r03", "read") :- user_role(User, Role), permit(Role, "r03", "read").

% Answer is users who have permission and are not revoked
answer(User) :- has_permission(User, "r03", "read"), not revoked(User, "r03").

import "grant.csv" as grant.
import "includes.csv" as includes.
import "member.csv" as member.
import "permit.csv" as permit.
import "revoked.csv" as revoked.

% Closure of roles
role_closure(Role, Role).
role_closure(Role, CR) :- includes(Role, CR).
role_closure(Role, CR) :- includes(Role, Intermediate), role_closure(Intermediate, CR).

% User's roles through group membership
user_role(Role) :- member("u04", Group), grant(Group, Role).

% All roles including transitively included ones
all_roles(Role) :- user_role(Initial), role_closure(Initial, Role).

% Resources accessible through permits
accessible(Resource) :- all_roles(Role), permit(Role, Resource, Action).

% Exclude revoked resources
answer(Resource) :- accessible(Resource), not revoked("u04", Resource).
